name: Hotel Martinez
positioning: Art Deco palace hotel on La Croisette in Cannes, now Hotel Martinez - The Unbound Collection by Hyatt
best_for: Travelers who want a Croisette base a short walk from the sea
Guests looking for large suites with private sea-view terraces

facts.text: Hotel Martinez sits at the centre of La Croisette, the road that curves along the coastline of Cannes.
The hotel is about a 30-second walk from the sea.
Emmanuel Michele Martinez bought the land in 1927 and first opened it as a hotel in 1929.
The rooms and suites are inspired by the hotel's 1930s Art Deco style and the colors of the French Riviera.
The rooms were designed by Paris-based designer Pierre-Yves Rochon in pale blue, white and gold.
Premium Sea View rooms with balcony open onto an Art Deco columned balcony overlooking the Mediterranean.
The Family Room connects a Junior Suite with a Premium city-view room and sleeps up to five guests.
The spa has a traditional hammam, plus a barber, a hairdresser and space for manicures and pedicures.
The Penthouse Apartments come with butler service.
La Palme d'Or serves its menus overlooking the Bay of Cannes from floor-to-ceiling windows.
Room service is available 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: On the seventh floor, the Penthouse Apartments have cinema-inspired decor paying tribute to actress Isabelle Huppert and Cannes Film Festival General Delegate Thierry Fremaux, with 180-degree views over the Bay of Cannes.
The Suite des Oliviers has a 250-square-meter private terrace with sea views.
At L'Oasis, manicured gardens lead to a swimming lane, in an area designed as a tranquil refuge from the streets outside.
The spa is run in partnership with the French brand Carita.
La Plage du Martinez is the hotel's beach club.

considerations.text: Rooms at the back of the hotel overlook the gardens and pool rather than the sea.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive Cannes location.
WhataHotel notes the high-profile location attracts celebrity clientele and paparazzi.
